title: gypsophila montana subsp. somalensis
intro: Gypsophila montana subsp. somalensis, commonly known as the Somali gypsophila or Somali baby's breath, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gypsophila montana subsp. somalensis include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
